The full setup, authoring, customisation, building, and publishing guide for [prodockit-template](https://github.com/buckwem/prodockit-template) and other Zensical projects built on the [prodockit](https://github.com/buckwem/prodockit-extensions) package.

Read it live at **[docs.prodockit.org](https://docs.prodockit.org/)**.

## Why a separate repo?

This content used to live in `docs/starthere/` inside prodockit-template itself, duplicated into every fork of that template the moment it was created. Any later fix or improvement had no way to reach a fork that already existed. Hosting it here instead means it's a normal, always-current website, independent of any individual fork's state - see [prodockit-template#49](https://github.com/buckwem/prodockit-template/issues/49).

## Building locally

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
zensical serve
```
